title: How Libra loves in winter
old_caption: Libra, you could plan the prettiest winter walk in your sleep. Try handing them the map this time. Letting them choose is its own kind of romance.

title: How Scorpio loves in winter
old_caption: Long nights and deep talks suit you, Scorpio. You don't have to open up all at once. Let them in one layer at a time, at a pace that feels safe.

title: How Sagittarius loves in winter
old_caption: Sagittarius, you can pack for a snow trip in four seconds. Before you go, ask whether they want the adventure or the sofa. A good trip can wait a weekend.

title: How Capricorn loves in winter
old_caption: Capricorn, you show love by shoveling their path before they're even awake. Don't slip away afterwards. Knock, and let them say thank you.

title: How Aquarius loves in winter
old_caption: Aquarius, a snow robot that says hi is a very you way to flirt. Big gestures are fun, but sometimes all they want is a simple hello from you.

title: How Pisces loves in winter
old_caption: Pisces, crying at the first snowflake isn't too much. It's how you love. Bring that soft heart into winter and feel it all, out loud.

title: Aries' holiday blind spot
old_caption: Aries, saying yes to every party for both of you comes from a good place. Their calendar is theirs, though. Ask first, then RSVP together.

title: Taurus' holiday blind spot
old_caption: Taurus, your traditions are part of who you are. Theirs are too. This year, try one bite of their holiday and see what it adds to yours.

title: Gemini's holiday blind spot
old_caption: Three parties in one night is a lot of fun and not much time together. Gemini, pick one, stay till the last song, and stay where they are.

title: Cancer's holiday blind spot
old_caption: Cancer, you host it all and eat last, and usually cold. The people at your table came to see you. Sit down, pass the plate and let yourself be a guest.
